visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black cap with a 'Jurassic Park' logo and a green plaid shirt speaks directly to the camera in a brightly lit retail environment. He stands in front of a white and green Gashapon vending machine, gesturing with his hands and smiling at the camera. (2) The camera zooms in to a close-up of the Gashapon machine's display panel, showing illustrations of characters from the 'Hunter x Hunter' anime in black and white. Information about the product and pricing is clearly visible on the interface. (3) The man holds a small white cup in one hand and turns a large green dial on the machine with his other hand. His facial expression shows anticipation as he operates the mechanical device. (4) A flat, square cardboard package is dispensed from the machine. The man retrieves it and presents the front of the packaging, which features prominent 'HUNTER x HUNTER' branding, to the camera lens. (5) He opens the cardboard sleeve to reveal a circular, black-and-white rubber coaster. He holds the item close to the camera, showcasing the profile design of the character. He nods and smiles, appearing satisfied with the result. (6) The man repeats the process by inserting coins and turning the dial again. He dispenses a second package and reveals another character coaster, Meruem. He displays both items side-by-side against the backdrop of the store. (7) In the final segment, the man holds both coasters up to the camera, highlighting how they face each other. He gives a friendly recommendation while background shoppers and other Gashapon machines are visible in the soft-focus background.
